Module-Trait and Environmental Factor Correlation Heatmap

Source: R/type_module_trait.R
type_module_trait.Rd

Creates publication-ready correlation heatmaps linking biological network modules (e.g. WGCNA module eigengenes, microbial cluster abundances, metabolic modules) with external environmental factors, clinical phenotypes, or physiological exposures (e.g., pH, temperature, humidity, pollution, SCORAD, age, TEWL). Computes and displays correlation coefficients (\(r\) or \(\rho\)), exact two-sided p-values, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR adjustments, significance asterisks, and optional hierarchical clustering for modules and environmental factors.

Usage

type_module_trait(
  method = c("pearson", "spearman"),
  cor_col = NULL,
  p_col = NULL,
  show_labels = c("both", "coef_stars", "coef", "stars", "none"),
  sig_digits = 2,
  colors = c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"),
  limits = c(-1, 1),
  cluster_modules = FALSE,
  cluster_env = FALSE,
  p_cutoff = NULL,
  border_color = "#E2E8F0",
  border_size = 0.35,
  text_size = 3,
  text_color = "auto",
  legend_title = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL
)

Arguments

method

Correlation method: "pearson" (default) or "spearman".

cor_col

Column name for correlation coefficients in precomputed data (default auto-detected: "cor", "r", "rho", "estimate").

p_col

Column name for p-values in precomputed data (default auto-detected: "pvalue", "p", "pval", "padj", "qvalue").

show_labels

Cell annotation format: "both" ("0.42\n(p=0.01)", default), "coef_stars" ("0.42***"), "coef" ("0.42"), "stars" ("***"), or "none".

sig_digits

Number of decimal digits for correlation coefficient (default 2).

colors

Diverging color gradient vector of length 3 (low, mid, high). Default c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B") (standard blue-white-red).

limits

Numeric vector of length 2 for color scale limits (default c(-1, 1)).

cluster_modules

Logical. If TRUE, reorders module rows using hierarchical clustering. Default FALSE.

cluster_env

Logical. If TRUE, reorders environmental factor columns using hierarchical clustering. Default FALSE.

p_cutoff

Optional significance threshold (e.g. 0.05). If provided, cells with p-values exceeding this cutoff will have blanked text labels.

border_color

Outline color for tiles (default "#E2E8F0").

border_size

Stroke width for tile borders (default 0.35).

text_size

Font size for cell annotations (default 3.0).

text_color

Text color. If "auto" (default), selects high-contrast text color based on cell fill.

legend_title

Title for color legend (default expression(italic(r))).

xlab, ylab

Axis labels.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Precomputed module-trait correlations
cor_df <- expand.grid(
  Module = c("M1_Inflammation", "M2_SkinBarrier", "M3_Microbiome"),
  Factor = c("Skin_pH", "Humidity", "SCORAD")
)
cor_df$cor <- c(0.45, -0.22, 0.65, -0.38, 0.52, -0.15, 0.72, 0.48, -0.31)
cor_df$pvalue <- c(0.001, 0.08, 1e-5, 0.005, 0.0001, 0.25, 1e-7, 0.0002, 0.01)

cliplot(Module ~ Factor, data = cor_df, type = type_module_trait())
} # }
